chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya'qub, from Abi Hammam, from Abi al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
“The adhan and the iqamah are two by two.”

And he said: “If he gives the iqamah two by two and does not give the adhan, that suffices him for the obligatory salat. But whoever gives the iqamah for the salat one by one and does not give the adhan, it does not suffice him except with an adhan.”

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it sufficed him / fulfilled the requirement for him
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةُ: the call marking the immediate commencement of salat
key_terms.مَثْنَى مَثْنَى: in pairs, phrase by phrase repeated two times

ai.seo_question: When does the iqamah suffice without the adhan in obligatory salat?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prescribed form of the adhan and iqamah as being recited in pairs. It also gives a legal ruling for obligatory salat: an iqamah recited in pairs can suffice without the adhan, but if the iqamah is recited singly, it does not suffice unless accompanied by the adhan.
